ablation: Window W=50 (same Laplace form): window-size sensitivity. If W=50 beats W=200 the choice of window is load-bearing and reported as such.
baseline: Sequential Laplace-smoothed climatology on the same o sequence (the CALIB-01 baseline, recomputed on fresh-seed data).
conditions: changing_rule v1.0.0, arch_b, affect='none', action_mode default (as in CALIB-01), 10 episodes x 5 fresh seeds {73601,73602,73603,73604,73605}, PredictionLog JSONL per seed, pooled in seed order (73601..73605, tick order) = 1950 ticks/domain. Estimator runs over the pooled stream with NO reset at seed boundaries (same information structure as the sequential-climatology baseline). Deterministic; stdlib only.
decision_use_protocol: SHARED (program step 3), runs ONLY if this family passes the gate. DU1 (D3 defer): online estimator; per tick if p_D3 > 0.5 take uniform-random action (seeded stream derive_seed(s,0,'defer')), else the agent's action. DU2 (D4 retrieval gate): per tick when a correction is available, apply iff p_D4 > 0.5 else skip (new RetrievalGate policy reading external p; code only if needed). Arms paired on 4 fresh seeds {73701,73702,73703,73704} x 10 episodes changing_rule. Metric: mean episode return. Win: seed-mean Delta(gated-blind) > 0 AND >=3/4 seeds agree on sign. Firing rate reported; rate 0 = decision-inert finding. Family is DECISION-USEFUL iff gate pass AND >=1 DU win; calibrated-but-inert caps at INTEGRATED.

estimator_spec.probability: p_t = (1 + #{window: event true}) / (2 + W_t), W_t = min(t, W): Laplace-smoothed empirical event rate over the trailing window. t=0 -> 0.5. No warmup; all 1950 ticks scored.
estimator_spec.rationale: No distributional assumptions: the probability IS the recent empirical rate. Adapts to nonstationarity (rule flips) faster than the all-history running average.
estimator_spec.sigma_for_corr: std of y over the trailing window (1.0 if <2 samples).

frozen_gates: G0 fabrication-tripwire CLEAN on new code, pre-run
G1 determinism spot-check: seed 73601 reference stream recomputed -> JSONL bytes identical, else VOID
G2 hash-chained receipt via harness.write_receipt + verify_chain
gate: SHARED GATE (program step 1): PASS iff Brier_est < Brier_climo on >=3/4 domains (>=3/4 bar follows lab precedent EXP-FP-0070/71/72). corr(sigma,|err|) reported, no threshold. REJECT otherwise: full negative-result entry, move on. No exceptions, no 'promising direction' softening.
hypothesis: A rolling-window empirical event rate (W=200, Laplace-smoothed) beats sequential climatology on >=3/4 calibration domains: Brier_roll < Brier_climo.
limitations_preregistered: Single env (changing_rule); the window's edge, if any, comes from adapting to flip-induced nonstationarity.
Pooled-stream estimator sees seed-boundary discontinuities (same order as baseline).
maturity_mapping: Gate pass -> EXECUTED with measured Brier skill (observer estimator, not wired). DU win -> CAUSAL. Gate fail -> REJECTED + NR entry.
null: Brier_roll >= Brier_climo on >=2/4 domains (fails the >=3/4 bar): recency carries no probabilistic information beyond the running base rate.
preregistered_metric: Per-domain Brier_roll vs Brier_climo (sequential Laplace-smoothed climatology), scored by benchmarks/calibration_battery.py score_domain on the pooled tick stream. PASS iff Brier_roll < Brier_climo on >=3/4 domains. A domain scoring UNMEASURABLE under CALIB-01's gates counts as not-beaten. corr(sigma,|err|) reported per domain (Pearson, pooled scored ticks); no threshold (supplementary, per program step 1).
seed_freshness: 73601-73605 verified absent from all receipts, preregistrations, and driver files (grep 2026-10-07). No overlap with calib 73101-73105 or any other experiment's seeds.
